$comment: `long double` in a position-independent executable (D-CONFIG-LONG-DOUBLE-REFUSED-ON-PIE-SHARED-AND-DLL-FORMATS): statics, an exported global, a constant table reached through a table of pointers, a pointer to the global and a function pointer — every address in it written by the dynamic loader — summed to 42, with a `char`-then-`long double` member checked for its alignment. `main.c` lists the codes. ✔MEASURED 2026-09-22, each reference separately: gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 build it `-fPIE -pie` (ET_DYN) and run it to 42 on x86_64 and on aarch64 (qemu), at -O0 and -O2. ✔MEASURED at the P68 round-8 part-4 base: DSS refused it on both ELF `-pie` targets, debug and release (S_LongDoubleFormatUndeclared: the `-pie` documents declared no `longDoubleFormat`). ★ The `release` arm: the index and the function pointer are `volatile`, so the relocated pointers are still followed at run time.
